title: The Shadows of Secrecy
story: In the dimly lit streets of the old town district, a chilling event unfolded. Residents of 'Whisperside Alley' recount tales of mysterious shadows darting between the mosaic-tiled houses. On a chilly night, the unmistakable scent of sulfur permeated the air, and a screech echoed through the alley - the body of a notorious gang leader, Mr. Ezra Blackwood, found lifeless. The alley stood still as the moonlight illuminated the scene.
crimeScene: Whisperside Alley, surrounded by mosaic-tiled houses.
forensicClue: The distinct odor of sulfur at the crime scene.
question: Who is the culprit and how was Mr. Blackwood killed? (Answer: Suspect 3, Reason: The broken bottle found beside the body.)
options: Option A (Suspect 1 and reason: No motive, no alibi, and a history of animosity with Mr. Blackwood's right-hand man)
Option B (Suspect 2 and reason: Had been seen arguing with Mr. Blackwood just hours before the crime, but witnesses place them at a charity event during the alleged murder time)
Option C (Suspect 3 and reason: Found with a broken bottle beside Mr. Blackwood's lifeless body, suggesting foul play)
Option D (Suspect 4 and reason: Closely associated with Mr. Blackwood, having business dealings the night before at Blackwood's office)
